name: Larsen & Toubro Limited
one_liner: Larsen & Toubro provides engineering, procurement, construction, heavy manufacturing, and technology services to enterprise and government clients globally.
what_you_sell: Engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) services, heavy manufacturing, precision engineering, defense equipment, and technology consulting services.
target_group: Larsen & Toubro sells to large enterprises, energy developers, and government or defense authorities. These buyers operate in heavy industry, energy, utilities, public transit, defense, or high-tech sectors with multi-million dollar project budgets. A good prospect is an enterprise or government entity undertaking large-scale infrastructure, gas compression, defense procurement, or hyperscale data center construction.
who_uses_it: Project managers, plant engineers, corporate IT teams, and public infrastructure operators working within L&T-built facilities or systems.
who_pays_for_it: Enterprise executives, government procurement authorities, defense agencies, and energy project developers.
who_buys_it: Enterprise executives, government procurement authorities, defense agencies, and energy project developers.
